title: Delivery Claims Schedule A: Claim Types, Claim Scope and Reporting Windows
content:
Schedule A sets, for each of the six Delivery Claims types, what one claim covers, the order condition it is opened against, and the time limits that govern when it may be opened.

## A.1 Claim types and their entry conditions

| Claim type | One claim covers | Order condition and record the type is opened against |
|---|---|---|
| Late Delivery Claim | the whole parcel | order delivered or closed; the order's delivery service carries a guaranteed delivery date |
| Delivered Not Received Claim | the whole parcel | order delivered; a carrier delivered scan is on record |
| Lost in Transit Claim | the whole parcel | order shipped; no carrier movement for the lost threshold below |
| Damaged in Transit Claim | the claimed order lines | order delivered or closed; photos of the damaged item and its packaging |
| Missing Item Claim | the claimed order lines | order delivered or closed; a photo of the opened parcel and its contents |
| Wrong Item Claim | the claimed order lines | order delivered or closed; a photo of the item received with its label |

A parcel-scope claim is measured over the whole order; a line-scope claim is measured over the order lines it claims.

## A.2 Time limits by claim type

| Claim type | Reporting window (calendar days) | Window counted from | Wait after the delivered scan (calendar days) | Lost threshold, Economy Ground, Pickup Point Delivery, Standard Ground (business days) | Lost threshold, faster services (business days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Late Delivery Claim | 30 | delivered date | 0 (none) | 0 (not a lost claim) | 0 (not a lost claim) |
| Delivered Not Received Claim | 30 | delivered date | 2 | 0 (not a lost claim) | 0 (not a lost claim) |
| Lost in Transit Claim | 60 | shipped (dispatch) date | 0 (none) | 5 | 2 |
| Damaged in Transit Claim | 7 | delivered date | 0 (none) | 0 (not a lost claim) | 0 (not a lost claim) |
| Missing Item Claim | 14 | delivered date | 0 (none) | 0 (not a lost claim) | 0 (not a lost claim) |
| Wrong Item Claim | 30 | delivered date | 0 (none) | 0 (not a lost claim) | 0 (not a lost claim) |

The faster services are Expedited 2-Day, Next Business Day and Same-Day Courier.

## A.3 Terms common to every claim type

| Term | Value for all six types |
|---|---|
| Claims of one type per order that are not withdrawn | 1 |
| Parcel misdelivered because of an address error the customer made | excluded — not a claim |
| Parcel returned from a pickup point because it was not collected | excluded — not a claim |
| Customer files anything with the carrier | no — Marlowe & Finch deals with the carrier |

## A.4 Reading the schedule

- A Lost in Transit Claim is the only type whose window counts from the dispatch of the order; every other type counts from the date the order was delivered.
- The Delivered Not Received Claim is the only type with a wait after the delivered scan: 2 calendar days.
- Only the Lost in Transit Claim has lost thresholds: 5 business days without carrier movement on Economy Ground, Pickup Point Delivery or Standard Ground, 2 business days on Expedited 2-Day, Next Business Day or Same-Day Courier. A 0 in those columns means the type is not a lost claim.
- Hypothetical example: an order holding a Missing Item Claim (status opened) cannot receive a second Missing Item Claim, because the limit of 1 per type counts every claim that is not withdrawn; a Damaged in Transit Claim on the same order is a different type and is not affected by that limit.
